# Zoe's Hotel & Suites, Faliraki, Rhodes

> Family-run 3-star hotel in Ladiko, on the edge of Faliraki, Rhodes, Greece. 48 Superior Rooms for families (32 m², up to 3 adults or 2 adults + 2 children, furnished balcony) and 10 adults-only (21+) Swim-Up Suites (30 m² + 13 m² veranda, king bed, swim-up access to a private pool, max 2 guests). 200 m² pool, children's pool, playground, the Zoes restaurant (Greek and international, all day), buffet breakfast, pool snack bar. Ladiko beach 900 m; Anthony Quinn Bay about 15 minutes on foot; Faliraki centre 1.5 km; Rhodes airport 16 km (about 20 min, ~€33 by taxi). Open 15 May to 15 October. Check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00. Best rate guaranteed when booking direct.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://zoes.gr/): the hotel, rooms, suites, pool and dining, location and distances, booking questions
- [Superior Room](https://zoes.gr/rooms/superior-rooms): family rooms, facts, amenities, 3D photo tour
- [Swim-Up Suite](https://zoes.gr/rooms/swim-up-suites): adults-only suites, facts, amenities, 3D photo tour
- [Greek version](https://zoes.gr/el): the same pages in Greek

## Booking and contact
- Book direct: https://zoeshotelfaliraki.reserve-online.net/
- Phone: +30 22410 85140 · Mobile: +30 694 769 6008 · Email: info@zoes.gr
- Address: Ladiko, Faliraki, 851 05 Rhodes, Greece

## Policies
- Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival; later changes or cancellations 30% of the stay; no-show 100%. Non-refundable rates are charged in full at booking.
- A deposit confirms the booking. Visa, MasterCard, American Express. Taxes included in online prices.

## Out of scope
- No pets. No children in the Swim-Up Suites. Closed from mid-October to mid-May. Not an all-inclusive resort.
